The Story
Cascade Precision Machining
Founded in 1994, Cascade Precision Machining is a trusted contract manufacturer for demanding industrial and commercial customers, specializing in tight-tolerance CNC machining of complex components.
Business Overview

Revenue is anchored by multi-year supply agreements with five OEM customers, none representing more than 22% of sales. A seasoned operations team runs the floor day to day, and the current owner has stepped back to a strategic role, positioning the business for a smooth ownership transition.

With a full order book, recent investment in five-axis capacity, and a fragmented supplier base ripe for consolidation, the business offers a strong platform for a strategic acquirer or an operator seeking an established, cash-generative manufacturer.

Investment Highlights
  • ✓ 30-year operating history with a blue-chip customer base
  • ✓ ISO 9001 certified, creating high switching costs
  • ✓ Diversified revenue, no customer above 22% of sales
  • ✓ Experienced management team already running operations
  • ✓ Recent five-axis investment with excess capacity to grow
  • ✓ Consistent double-digit EBITDA margins
